direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has just asked Kasun about his small food business. They linger beside his three-wheeler in the overcast daylight.
direction.people: Anudi stands left, facing Kasun, in a cream blouse and muted teal skirt. She holds her phone at her right waist and an open umbrella in her left hand, with her handbag on her left forearm; she is curious and at ease. Kasun stands right facing her, in a faded blue shirt and dark trousers, his empty hands at his sides; he is friendly and modest.

flow.text: They stay turned toward each other. Kasun meets her expectant gaze.

flow.how: Friendly and unembarrassed, confirming his modest start with a slight nod
flow.listener: Anudi keeps her eyes on him, listening with quiet interest.

flow.text: Anudi raises her eyebrows slightly, her attention still on him.

flow.how: After a brief beat, warmly curious and keen to understand his work, tilting her head a fraction toward him
flow.listener: Kasun watches her, receptive and at ease.

flow.text: Anudi waits with a small smile. Kasun draws a quiet breath.

direction.camera: A locked-off, eye-level waist-up two-shot from the road side on a 40mm lens, with the three-wheeler behind Kasun.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
